Description: "Fix cart sidebar item matching for products with option modifiers. Previously, modifying quantity or deleting an option-configured item in the cart would apply to all items of the same ID. This updates those functions to compare both ID, price tiers, and modifier keys."
Instruction: "Compare modifiers list equality when updating cart item quantity or deleting items from the cart."
